# Independent synthetic research-organization benchmark

All fixtures and values are independently authored synthetic test cases, not unseen real projects. The fixture author did not inspect organizer skill code, prior fixtures or MAESTRO business files. Canonical reports express correct semantic states, not required templates. Accept equivalent wording and folder schemes.

Worker isolation: copy only the selected case/stage directory into a fresh run workspace and provide its neutral prompt. Never expose private/, this guide, generation code, answer JSON, other stage snapshots or manifests containing canonical report hashes. Workers must not inspect parent directories or external fixture directories.

First-stage input is initial/. Unchanged-stage input is maintenance_snapshot/. Incremental-stage input is incremental_input/: an independent correct old report with the source overlay already applied. incremental_maintenance_snapshot/ is evaluator-only reference output. increment_overlay/ records added/replaced sources. All maintenance workers start in fresh contexts, independent of previous worker outputs. Disclose this cold-context setup rather than implying continuous conversational maintenance.

Use 5 paired repetitions per stage (15 paired runs / 30 worker runs), distributing repetitions over the two cases. Pair byte-identical source trees and the same model/effort/tools across conditions. There are only two independent synthetic cases, reused across stages and repetitions. Do not present 15 pairs as 15 independent projects or generalize to unseen real-project reliability. Model/tool stochasticity, repeated-case dependence, case selection and synthetic scope limit interpretation.

Read answer_rubric.json for exact scientific facts and source-line evidence. Each applicable criterion receives 0, 0.5 or 1 times its weight, with a concrete justification citing the output and input. Score semantics rather than keyword presence. For example, mentioning an OOM does not pass if the failed run also enters the mean. The existence of a link does not pass if its source contradicts the attached claim. Record missing and incorrect facts per run, unresolved ambiguity and constructive corrective feedback.

Initial/unchanged maximum semantic score is 15; incremental is 19. In incremental runs initial_aggregation tests denominator and estimator principles, while increment_correction tests updated numbers. Numeric tolerance is 0.0005. A report may express the average as 1.5 percentage points if the scale is explicit. Do not call a 0.015 ARI difference a 1.5% relative improvement. An accurate report omitting redundant derived means may still pass if all paired values, n, directions and scope are clear; record reporting completeness separately. Do not double-penalize a single arithmetic mistake across unrelated scope criteria.

Hard preservation gate: unrelated/ and protected/ require identical bytes and relative paths. All original observations, protocols, negative and failure records, replay limits, corrections and historical drafts must remain recoverable without loss of content or provenance. In-scope evidence may move if citations/navigation follow it. Consolidation is acceptable if original information remains traceable; retaining a historical false claim as current truth is not required. Record deleted/rewritten evidence separately from protected-byte failures. Reject fabricated experimental claims or new training/data retrieval.

One report means one identifiable authoritative current account. Clearly labeled historical drafts are allowed. A renamed report or separate navigation page is acceptable. Resolve relative citations and compare stated facts with cited source text and any line numbers. Source-line shifts alone are not a failure if the source and fact remain unambiguous. Navigation must make relevant retained evidence discoverable and not leave broken paths after reorganization.

Unchanged maintenance: a correct report should remain materially stable. Prefer a byte-stable current report and no gratuitous source churn. A documented factual or navigational repair is acceptable; stylistic rewrites alone count as unnecessary maintenance, separately from semantic correctness. Existing canonical reports are correct but no exact wording or folder scheme is a scoring requirement.

Capture wall time, tool calls, tokens when available, touched paths, content hashes and report churn. Efficiency is secondary to semantics and preservation. Timeouts and worker failures remain in the denominator. Evaluate blind to comparator labels if practical. Do not inspect or edit organizer implementation while acting as evaluator.
